response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(L.HGB / L.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX) SELECT ID, SEX, avg_wbc, ratio, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM p) AS gap FROM p WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM p) ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
